StoryTeller2.CopyIDMessage: The macro for calling the story was copied to the clipboard.
StoryTeller2.Settings.Size: The size of the story on the screen
StoryTeller2.Settings.SizeHint: 100% takes up almost the entire screen height, 80% takes up no more than 80% of the screen height
StoryTeller2.Settings.UseDialogV2Hint: On for Foundry V13 and newer. Turn off to use the legacy dialogs (required on V12).
StoryTeller2.Settings.ImageFilterHint: Applies a CSS filter to images in the book
STORYTELLER.ImporterHint: Upload a .txt or .epub file, for example from Project Gutenberg (gutenberg.org, choose EPUB). Every chapter becomes a page of a new StoryTeller Journal.
STORYTELLER.ImporterImagesHint: Stores the images of an EPUB in this world's folder (worlds/<world>/story-teller-x). Turn off for a book without pictures.
StoryTeller2.Settings.PageNumbersDefault: Default for books that have no page number choice of their own. The GM can change it per book with the page number button in the book header.
STORYTELLER.Option.pageNumbersHint: Print a page number on every page and show it in the table of contents.
STORYTELLER.Option.autoSplitHint: Long text pages are cut into several book pages, so nothing needs scrolling. Each journal page becomes a chapter.
STORYTELLER.Option.autoFloatHint: Small images float left and right with the text around them. Needs automatic splitting.
STORYTELLER.Option.chaptersOnRight: Chapters start on a right-hand page
STORYTELLER.Option.chaptersOnRightHint: Adds a blank page where needed. Needs automatic splitting.
STORYTELLER.Option.tocHeadings: Headings in the table of contents
STORYTELLER.Option.hideTocNumbers: Hide numbers in the table of contents
STORYTELLER.Option.hideTocNumbersHint: Removes the page numbers from the table of contents list.
STORYTELLER.Option.fontFamilyHint: Font used for the text of the book.
STORYTELLER.Option.fontColorDefault: Use the default of the page color
STORYTELLER.Option.fontColorHint: Black pages default to bright grey text.
STORYTELLER.Option.tocHeadingsHint: Lists the headings (levels 1 to 3) of each chapter below it. Needs automatic splitting.
StoryTeller2.Settings.PdfSheetHint: Select an alternative journal sheet to use for journals containing PDF pages. If set to Default, no override is applied.
STORYTELLER.Importer.sheetTypeHint: Story Book shows the text as a book with cover, pages and page numbers.
STORYTELLER.Importer.pageColorHint: The page color sets the default text color (bright grey on black pages).
STORYTELLER.Chapter.title: Chapter settings
STORYTELLER.Chapter.showTitleHint: Print the title of the chapter at the top of its first page.
STORYTELLER.Chapter.filterHint: Lays the page texture over the whole page with a blend mode, so text and images pick up the grain of the paper.
